nodes.text: _Rates vary by facility and by patient plan tier. Table 1 gives base rates; Tables 2 and 3 give the multipliers._
1.1 This Agreement is made between Meridian Health Assurance Group (the "Payer") and Pelham Health Network (the "Provider"), and runs from 1 January 2024 to 31 December 2025.
1.2 The Provider operates the following facilities. The facility code recorded on a line item determines which column of Table 2 applies.
1.3 Patients are enrolled in one of the following plan tiers. The plan tier recorded on an invoice determines which column of Table 3 applies to every line item on that invoice.
2.1 "Service Day" means the calendar day recorded as the Service Date of the line item.
2.2 "Business Day" means any Service Day other than a Saturday or a Sunday.
2.3 "Unit" means one billable unit of a Service on the unit basis recorded in Table 1.
2.4 "Effective unit rate" means the amount produced by applying Section 3 to the base rate in Table 1.

3.1 Where more than one adjustment applies to the same Service, the adjustments shall be applied to the base rate strictly in the following order: (a) substitution of a bundled rate; (b) the facility multiplier; (c) the plan-tier multiplier; (d) any premium or uplift; and (e) any cumulative volume discount. The line total is then the resulting unit rate multiplied by the billed quantity.

3.2 All monetary amounts are expressed in whole cents. Where the application of a multiplier, premium or discount produces a fraction of a cent, the result shall be rounded to the nearest whole cent, with exact halves rounded away from zero ("half up"). Rounding is applied after each individual step of the calculation, not once at the end.

3.3 In full, the calculation is: take the base rate for the Service from Table 1 (or the substituted bundled rate from Section 7 where that applies); multiply by the facility multiplier for that Service and facility from Table 2; multiply by the plan-tier multiplier for that Service and tier from Table 3; apply any premium from Section 5 or Section 6; and finally apply any cumulative volume discount from Section 8. Round half up to the nearest cent after each of those steps.
3.4 A multiplier of 1.0 leaves the amount unchanged, but the rounding step is still taken.
